RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the August 22, 2007/Sravana 31, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
45
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Problems with acquiring Admiral
Gorshkov aircraft carrier
*141. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the problems that India is
encountering with acquisition of Admiral
Gorshkov aircraft carrier;
(b) whether it is a fact that Russia is
demanding more money for refurbishing and
delivering the same by August, 2008;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the Defence Minister is going
to visit Russia in October, 2007, to discuss
various aspects of Gorshkov deal; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
 Export of iron ore
*142. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that substantial
volume of iron ore is being exported by
various PSUs and companies in private
sector;
(b) if so, the details of annual volume
and value of iron ore exports since 2002-03
till 30th June, 2007;
(c) whether duties have been levied by
Government on iron ore export
consignments;
(d) if so, the details of genesis of export
duty levied on iron ore indicating rates
thereof since its inception till 30th June,
2007;
(e) the date of its last revision; and
(f) whether it was revised due to
demands from stakeholders or unilaterally
by Government?
 Guidelines on indecent print and
telecast
†*143. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
guidelines to control indecent print and

46
telecast in electronic media which pollute
culture, tradition and civilization of the
country;
(b) if so, the details of these guidelines
and mediums which have contributed in
their preparation;
(c) if the guidelines have not been
prepared, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether it is a fact that such telecast
are going on in the country in the name of
freedom of expression?
 Security experts’ demand for a tough
and stringent anti-terror law
*144. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether demand for a tough and
stringent anti-terror law to deal with threats
from across the border to the country's vital
installations, including nuclear facilities, has
been raised by top security experts;
(b) whether existing laws are woefully
inadequate to deal with the developing
threats;
(c) whether it has been suggested that
expert police which is the weapon of first
resort against terrorism of any kind, must
be adequately empowered and given full
latitude in dealing with terror and its nexus
with organized crime; and
(d) the other suggestions made and
considered by Government?
 Deplorable condition of AIR sub-
stations in North East
*145. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
all the sub-stations of All India Radio in
North Eastern region are working in
deplorable condition due to inadequate
technical staff, infrastructure, equipments
and poor management;
(b) if so, whether Government have any
policy to upgrade or improve all such sub-
stations; and
(c) whether any new sub-stations are
going to be set up in the region soon?
 Constructing new roads in NER
*146. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
constructing new roads in the rural/hilly/
backward areas of the country particularly
in the North Eastern Region (NER);
(b) if so, the total kilometres of roads to
be constructed in the country during the
year 2007-08, State-wise; and
(c) the details of total funds allotted to
these States for construction of roads in
rural areas of the country?
 Anusandhan Vikas Ratna and
Anusandhan Mini Vikas Ratna
*147. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
accord status of Anusandhan Vikas Ratna
and Anusandhan Mini Vikas Ratna to some
private companies in line with Raksha
Udyog Ratnas (RUR); and
(b) if so, the details of the same?

47
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Import of pulses
†*148. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the import
of pulses is being encouraged to increase
their availability in the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) the reasons for non-availability of
those economic incentives to private
sector's agencies which are available to
Government agencies for the import of
pulses; and
(d) the reasons for not seeking
cooperation of private sector in increasing
the availability of pulses in the country?
 Facilities for freedom fighters
†*149. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of the freedom fighters
in the country, State-wise;
(b) the facilities being provided by
Government to these freedom fighters;
(c) whether any proposal for enhancing
these facilities is under consideration of
Government; and
(d) if so, whether Government propose
to enhance these facilities?
 Killing of army officers by juniors
*150. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
army officers, during the last two years,
were killed by their juniors;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps Government have taken to
protect the lives of army officers?
 Objective of NREGA remains
unfulfilled
*151. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the objective
of NREGA to eradicate poverty still
remains unfulfilled since operationalising
in February, 2006;
(b) whether Government are aware that
provision of drinking water, sheds to
children of the labourers and first aid is
nowhere in sight; and
(c) if so, what is the reaction of
Government?
 Complaints regarding ALHs
†*152. SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI:
SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that all the three
Chiefs of Armed Forces have lodged their
complaints to Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd.
(HAL) regarding quality of Advanced Light
Helicopters (ALHs);
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that a
large number of such helicopters have
become inoperative for want of spare parts
and maintenance; and
(c) if so, the details of action taken by
Government in this regard?

48
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Criteria for SEZs
†*153. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have laid down
any criterion regarding Special Economic
Zone policy in the recent past;
(b) the benefit, farmers of the country
will get as a result thereof and whether they
will get full money for their land and what
are the State-wise details thereof;
(c) the number of SEZs approved in
Haryana after SEZ policy of Government
and the number of acres of land to be
acquired from the farmers;
(d) the amount of compensation per acre
to be paid to the farmers and the period
within which such compensation would be/
has been given to the farmers after land
acquisition; and
(e) the State-wise details of total
number of SEZs approved so far alongwith
the number of those which will be set up
on fertile land and waste land separately?
 Joint exercises with US
*154. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of joint Naval, Air and
Land exercises that have taken place
between India and U.S.A. during last five
years;
(b) the details of U.S. nuclear ships
participated in these joint exercises; and
(c) whether any ship with nuclear reactor
or arms from any other nation has also
docked at any of the Indian ports, or any
other facilities have been provided to them?
 Feedback on implementation of
NREGA
*155. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the implementation of
National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
(NREGA) completed a year on April 30,
the Government have got different feed-
back from different States and some States
are demanding extension of the NREG Act
and some other States remained lukewarm
to its implementation;
(b) whether NGOs of different States
have brought into focus other major issues
of concern before the Union and State
Governments;
(c) if so, what are the other main points
which are needed for overload job scheme;
and
(d) by what time these changes are
necessary to implement the scheme fully?
 Closure of NTC mill at Gulbarga
*156. SHRI K.B. SHANAPPA: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
closure of MSK mill of NTC at Gulbarga;
(b) if so, how many employees were
terminated and how many employees were
given VRS; and
(c) the details thereof?

49
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Funds for construction of border roads
in N.E. States
*157. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the amount allotted, during
2007-08, for construction of border roads
in North Eastern States; and
(b) the length of roads (in kms) expected
to be added with the allocated funds during
2007-08 in N.E. States especially in Assam?
 Coastal police stations
*158. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre has sanctioned 12
coastal police stations for Tamil Nadu,
equipped with speed-boats and modern
equipments to control infiltration;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether other coastal States have
also been sanctioned similar police stations
to control this menace; and
(d) if so, the details of such police
stations that have been sanctioned for
Orissa?
 Appointment of second State Re-
organisation Commission
*159. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
SHRI SHATRUGHAN SINHA
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
appointment of a second State Re-
organisation Commission for creation of
new States to attain political stability and
better governance; and
(b) if so, the salient features and details
of the proposal?
 Hike in cement price
†*160. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cement
companies have recently hiked the price of
cement;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that cement
companies had promised Government that
they will not increase the price of cement
for one year;
(d) whether it is also a fact that cement
companies have also reduced the
production of cement with a view to
continue hike in the market;
(e) if so, what is the cost of production
of cement vis-a-vis its sale-price; and
(f) the steps Government are taking to
safeguard the interests of the consumers?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Problems faced by paper industry
†1054. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards reduction in customs
duty and making the import of machines
used in paper industry duty-free by the
Indian paper industry;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to solve the problems faced by the Indian
paper industry;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this
industry is facing hardships due to non-
availability of raw material and non-
utilization of modern technique; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to remove these difficulties?
Pending issues of subsidy and funds
for Growth Centre in Sikkim
1055. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that two issues,
pertaining to Sikkim, for releasing of funds
for Growth Centre and Central Investment
Subsidy and Transport Subsidy, are
pending with Government;
(b) if so, since when and the reasons
therefor; and
(c) the details of the action taken by
Government in this regard?
Preferential Trade Agreement
between India and Israel
1056. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the study group of India
and Israel recommended for a Preferential
Trade Agreement between India and Israel;
(b) if so, whether negotiations on this
was held with the recently visited Deputy
Prime Minister of Israel;
(c) if so, the areas of discussion;
(d) whether the issue of issuing long-
term Visas to diamond traders of India has
been raised; and
(e) if so, Israel’s response thereto?

244
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Shortage of cement
1057. DR. V. MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
huge deficit of cement requirement in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the total production and
consumption of cement both in private and
public sectors in the country;
(d) what is the total demand of cement
in the country, State-wise;
(e) what is the total shortage vis-a-vis
production; and
(f) what steps are being taken to prevent
sale of cement in black markets?
FDI in agriculture
1058. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
SHRI K.E. ISMAIL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
a proposal to allow Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) in agriculture sector; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Permission to foreign companies for
retail business
†1059. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether permission is being granted
to the foreign companies by Government
to enter into the retail business in India;
(b) if so, whether Government's
attention has been drawn towards its effects
on the domestic retail business; and
(c) the steps taken to prevent the neglect
of domestic retail products and work force
by the multinational companies?
Overlap in the role of Tariff
Commission and Chief
Advisor Cost
1060. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a significant overlap
in the roles of the Tariff Commission under
Ministry of Commerce and Chief Advisor
Cost in Department of Revenue; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
merge the two or eliminate one of them?
Effect of appreciation of rupee on
exports
1061. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that appreciation
of rupee in comparison to dollar is going to
affect our export target which is going to
come down as per the survey conducted
by the ASSOCHEM;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
appreciation of rupee in comparison to
dollar during the period between January
to June, 2007 have been 8.35 per cent
whereas the appreciation in currency of
China, Russia and Brazil have been 1.82
per cent, 2.08 per cent and 9.8 per cent
respectively; and

245
(c) if so, how the country is going to
achieve the target of export and face the
challenge from countries like China, Russia
and Brazil?
Take over of closed tea gardens in
West Bengal
1062. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR
SEN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to take over some closed tea
gardens in West Bengal; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Smuggling of palm oil
1063. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a huge quantity of palm oil have been
smuggled into our country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
initiated any preventive measure to curb
such huge illegal inflow of palm oil into the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Exorbitant hike in cement price
†1064. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that cement manufacturing
companies of the country are increasing
the prices of cement exorbitantly by
forming a cartel;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices
Commission (MRTPC) has issued a notice
also to some companies in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government are considering
to administer the prices of cement in view
of the attitudes of the cement companies?
According priority to Agri Export
Zones
1065. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Agri Export Zones
(AEZs) numbering 60 and spread over 20
States have so far garnered an investment
of Rs. 866 crore and achieved export of
Rs. 5,413 crores over the last five years
against an envisaged investment of Rs. 1718
crore and exports of Rs. 11,822 crore;
(b) if so, whether any measures are being
taken to accord priority so as to attract
investment into this area and particularly
in the State of Andhra Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Trade on Attari-Wagah border
†1066. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
promote trade on Attari-Wagah border;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

246
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) by when it would be possible to
start trading on the said Indo-Pak border
alongwith the names of the products
proposed to be included in the trade?
Effects of study on big houses on
retail market
†1067. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any institute had been
entrusted the job to collect information
about the effects of big houses in the retail
market of the country;
(b) if so, the name of the institute and
time when this responsibility was
entrusted to it;
(c) whether there is any association of
representatives of non-unorganized retail
market in this institute;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether this institute has submitted
its interim report to Government;
(f) if so, the details of this report and
whether this report has been made public;
and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Special Economic Zones
1068. DR. BARUN MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the year/month-wise and State-wise
break up of the total number of SEZs
approved/awaiting approval from the date
of commencement till date; and
(b) the types of industry/project, area
(acres) involved and the proposed amount
of investment and expected employment
generation in each of these SEZs?
India's participation in Doha Talks
†1069. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether U.S.A. and other European
countries seem to agree to discontinue
subsidy amount of their respective country
given for agriculture to make progress in
Doha-talks under World Trade
Organisation;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) if U.S.A. and other European
countries do not agree on the above issue,
whether India would declare its decision
not to participate in the so called talks; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Extension of rebates to IT industry
†1070. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether IT industry is demanding
an exclusive SEZ for itself or its inclusion
in the existing SEZs;
(b) whether this demand of the industry
is based on its apprehension that the rebates
available to it would be withdrawn by 2009
and if  its SEZs are set up than these rebates
may be available for long term; and

247
(c) whether Government propose to
extend the rebates and concessions to IT
industry even beyond 2009 so that there
might not be any need of SEZ for this?
Separate deep sea fisheries body
under MPEDA
1071. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that MPEDA is
forming a separate body to focus directly
on deep sea fisheries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this off-shoot of MPEDA
will be based and made operational from
Visakhapatnam;
(d) in what way does MPEDA have
any experience of operating boats; and
(e) the steps proposed to ensure that
MPEDA focuses and concentrates on its
core duty of marine product exports only?
Centres for Agri-perishables for
exports
1072. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has identified 12 locations for setting up of
centres for handling agri-perishables for
exports at an estimated cost of Rs. 2500
crores;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
besides this the Ministry has announced
the development of six spice parks across
the country for various spices; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Failure of AEZs
1073. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that six years
after their inception not even one of the 60
approved Agri-Export Zones (AEZs),
precursors to today's dedicated export
zones, has taken off as per the Ministry's
plans;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a review
by the Ministry last year has revealed that
the zones had missed their export targets
and investments were only half of the
originally estimated Rs. 1,700 crore and
not a single zone is active; and
(c) if so, whether Government have tried
to investigate to find out reasons for failure
of AEZs and the action proposed to make
them a success?
Effect of unrestricted export of iron
ore
1074. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
iron ore from India is being exported
unrestrictedly, thus leading to a huge gap
between demand and supply in the country;
(b) whether Government are aware that
the demand for steel within the country is
increasing;
(c) what steps Government are planning
to take to regulate export of Iron ore from
the country; and
(d) if so, the time frame therefor?

248
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Effect of duty free import of vegetable
oil on Indian industries
†1075. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is an
import duty on raw palm oil, whereas
vegetable oil imported from Sri Lanka and
Nepal is completely duty free;
(b) whether it is also a fact that some
big companies manufacturing vegetable oil
are setting up their manufacturing units in
Sri Lanka and thus manufacturing vegetable
oil by purchasing palm oil from Malaysia
and thereafter exporting it to India;
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
this approximately half of the
manufacturing units engaged in vegetable
oil industry have been closed in the
country; and
(d) if so, what steps Government have
taken during the last one year to save the
vegetable oil industry of the country?
Increase in investment in Mumbai-
Delhi corridor infrastructure
project
1076. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
the investment in Mumbai-Delhi corridor
infrastructure project;
(b) what are the developments being
envisaged through the scheme;
(c) whether any foreign countries are
interested in the scheme; and
(d) the time limit of the scheme?
Effect of unsustainable tax breaks and
physical incentives to industrial
projects
1077. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Prime
Minister warned the State Governments
against unhealthy practice of providing
unsustainable tax breaks and physical
incentives to industrial projects at Northern
Chief Minister's Conclave organized by
PHD Chambers of Commerce and Industry
on 28th September, 2006 in Chandigarh;
(b) whether it is also a fact that he
advised to remove the barriers on Inter-
State trade; and
(c) if so, whether there is any proposal
before Government to implement the advise
of the Prime Minister?
Approval to SEZs
1078. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that approvals
for more than 150 SEZs have been granted
by Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the number of new approvals likely to be
accorded, State-wise;
(c) whether there is any proposal before
Government to change the guidelines and
rules for SEZs in view of the public
authority; and
(d) if so, the details thereof ?

249
